item.title: Gov. Whitmer says Supreme Court tariff decision is a 'step forward'
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) -- The U.S. Supreme Court ruled Friday that a significant portion of President Trump's sweeping tariffs were illegal, striking down the administration's use of emergency powers to reshape global trade. item.title: Trump announces new tariffs, investigations after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: President Trump said Friday he would raise preexisting tariffs and begin the process of imposing new ones after the Supreme Court struck down many of his import taxes on foreign trading partners.
